description.value:
Always on (automated): +1 to Reflex and Athlete checks.

Part of a Reaction: owning any Extra Skill with “Reaction” in its name gives you a second Defense each turn (automated). When you Defend or Dodge against a threat linked to Reflex and Athlete, add +1 to that roll.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
